forecast.scope: the zones of the plan it was made with, and what is done already

draft:
This week, teams completed 2 visits and 1 clearance. So far, 32 zones have been surveyed, 11 declared free, 38 areas released and 17 cleared. Mines were found in 12 areas; 576 suspected or confirmed areas remain open.

Officer attention: 19 zones are closed according to the access feed. No teams were stood down or had reports overdue by more than a week. No dossiers or reports were held or queried. No new plan was approved; the plan remains P12.

The week 49 forecast covers the zones of the plan it was made with, counting what is done already. Its range is 11–12 mine areas cleared and 11–11 zones declared free this season.
